pinyin: dà chù zhuó yǎn, xiǎo chù zhuó shǒu
literal: big · place · fix eyes, small · place · start hands

meaning.en: Keep the overall goal in view, but begin with concrete, small steps.
meaning.zh: 从全局考虑，从具体小事做起。

equivalents: keep the big picture but start with the details

examples.zh: 做事要大处着眼，小处着手。
examples.en: In any task, keep the big picture in mind and start with the details.

examples.zh: 创业者应大处着眼，小处着手。
examples.en: Entrepreneurs should aim high and start small.

usage.en: A piece of practical advice in management and study. Formal to neutral in tone.
usage.zh: 多用于管理、学习中的经验之谈，语体偏正式。

pinyin: tài yáng cóng xī biān chū lái
literal: sun · from · west · side · come out
natural: the sun rising in the west

meaning.en: Used to express surprise at something very unusual, often a person acting out of character.
meaning.zh: 比喻极不寻常的事，多用来表示惊讶。

equivalents: the sun must be rising in the west

examples.zh: 你主动洗碗？太阳从西边出来了！
examples.en: You're washing up on your own? Pigs might fly!

examples.zh: 他居然认错了，今天太阳从西边出来了吧。
examples.en: He actually admitted he was wrong; the sun must be rising in the west.

usage.en: Often with 今天 or 莫非, and often with the final 了. Also used to say something will never happen: 除非太阳从西边出来.
usage.zh: 常说“今天太阳从西边出来了”，也用于“除非太阳从西边出来”，表示绝不可能。

pinyin: fù nǚ néng dǐng bàn biān tiān
literal: women · can · hold up · half · sky
natural: women hold up half the sky

meaning.en: Women can do as much as men, and are half of society's strength.
meaning.zh: 妇女与男子一样能干，是社会的半边力量。

equivalents: women hold up half the sky

examples.zh: 新时代妇女能顶半边天。
examples.en: In the new era women hold up half the sky.

examples.zh: 女工们用行动证明了妇女能顶半边天。
examples.en: The women workers proved by their deeds that women can hold up half the sky.

usage.en: A slogan popularised in the 1950s and linked to Mao Zedong's encouragement of women to join production. Today a stock phrase for gender equality at work.
usage.zh: 20世纪50年代起流行的口号，鼓励妇女参加生产建设，现在常用来谈男女平等。

pinyin: zuǒ ěr jìn, yòu ěr chū
literal: left · ear · in, right · ear · out
natural: in one ear and out the other

meaning.en: To hear something without taking it in or acting on it.
meaning.zh: 听了不放在心上，不当一回事。

equivalents: in one ear and out the other
go in one ear, out the other

examples.zh: 妈妈说的话，他总是左耳进，右耳出。
examples.en: He always lets what his mother says go in one ear and out the other.

examples.zh: 老师讲了多少遍，你还是左耳进，右耳出。
examples.en: The teacher has said it so many times, yet it still goes in one ear and out the other.

usage.en: Same image as the English idiom. Can be the full phrase or 左耳朵进右耳朵出; also written 左耳入，右耳出.
usage.zh: 与英语同义说法意象相同，也说“左耳朵进右耳朵出”。

pinyin: zhāng jiā cháng, lǐ jiā duǎn
literal: Zhang · family · long, Li · family · short

meaning.en: Idle gossip about other people's affairs.
meaning.zh: 谈论别人家的是非，说长道短。

examples.zh: 她们整天坐在一起张家长，李家短。
examples.en: They sit together all day gossiping about everyone's business.

examples.zh: 不要总是张家长，李家短，多做点正事。
examples.en: Stop chattering about the neighbours' affairs and do something useful.

usage.en: 张 and 李 are the two commonest surnames, standing for 'anybody'. Often with 说 or 爱: 爱说张家长李家短.
usage.zh: 张、李是最常见的姓，泛指各家。常说“爱说张家长李家短”。

pinyin: zhàn wú bù shèng, gōng wú bù kè
literal: fight · none · not · win, attack · none · not · conquer

meaning.en: Victorious in every battle and conquering every target.
meaning.zh: 每战必胜，每攻必克，形容力量强大，所向无敌。

examples.zh: 这支军队战无不胜，攻无不克。
examples.en: This army wins every battle and takes every stronghold.

examples.zh: 只要团结，我们就能战无不胜，攻无不克。
examples.en: If we stay united, we can overcome every challenge.

usage.en: Used in military, sports and political slogans. Often reversed to 攻无不克，战无不胜. A little hyperbolic, formal.
usage.zh: 常用于军事、体育和政治口号。也可倒装为“攻无不克，战无不胜”。

pinyin: dǎ yī bā zhang, gěi gè tián zǎo
literal: strike · a · slap · give · a · sweet · date

meaning.en: To hurt someone and then offer a small favour to soothe them; a mix of harshness and sweeteners.
meaning.zh: 先给对方一点打击，再给一点好处来安抚。

examples.zh: 老板打一巴掌，给个甜枣，大家就都不闹了。
examples.en: The boss slapped and then sweetened, and everyone calmed down.

examples.zh: 别想着打一巴掌，给个甜枣就糊弄我。
examples.en: Don't think you can fob me off with a slap and a sweet date.

usage.en: Usually of a manipulative boss or parent. Also said 打一棒子给个甜枣. Dates (枣) are a popular sweet.
usage.zh: 多指上级或长辈软硬兼施。也说“打一棒子给个甜枣”。

pinyin: dǎ diào mén yá, wǎng dù zi lǐ yàn
literal: knocked · out · front teeth · into · belly · swallow
natural: swallow one's pride and one's pain

meaning.en: To swallow a humiliation or injury in silence because one has no choice.
meaning.zh: 吃了亏、受了委屈也只能自己忍着，不敢声张。

examples.zh: 被领导冤枉了，他只好打掉门牙，往肚子里咽。
examples.en: Blamed unjustly by his boss, he had to swallow it in silence.

examples.zh: 这个亏我只能打掉门牙，往肚子里咽。
examples.en: I'll just have to take this loss and keep quiet about it.

usage.en: The image is of having a tooth knocked out and swallowing it with the blood. Also 打落牙齿和血吞, a near-synonym.
usage.zh: 形象是被打掉牙齿也只能咽下去。近义说法为“打落牙齿和血吞”。

pinyin: bǎ xīn fàng zài dù zi lǐ
literal: put · heart · in · belly

meaning.en: To stop worrying and be reassured.
meaning.zh: 放心，不必担心。

examples.zh: 你把心放在肚子里吧，一切有我。
examples.en: Set your mind at ease; I'll take care of everything.

examples.zh: 听了医生的话，她终于把心放在肚子里。
examples.en: After hearing the doctor, she finally put her mind at rest.

usage.en: Used to soothe someone; typically an imperative: 把心放在肚子里。 Colloquial, mostly northern.
usage.zh: 多用于安慰人，常作祈使句，口语，北方多用。

pinyin: ná zhe jī máo dàng lìng jiàn
literal: take · chicken · feather · as · command · arrow
natural: treat a trifle as an order

meaning.en: To treat a trivial instruction as a weighty order, or to use a little authority to throw one's weight about.
meaning.zh: 把无足轻重的话当成重要命令，借机摆架子。

equivalents: make a mountain out of a molehill of orders
use a trifle as a pretext to throw one's weight around

examples.zh: 他拿着鸡毛当令箭，把小事搞得很紧张。
examples.en: He treats a trifle as a command and makes a fuss over small matters.

examples.zh: 别拿着鸡毛当令箭，吓唬新人。
examples.en: Don't use a trifle as an order to bully newcomers.

usage.en: 令箭 was an arrow-shaped token of military command; a chicken feather has no authority. Usually criticises officious people. Also said 拿鸡毛当令箭.
usage.zh: 令箭是传达军令的信物，鸡毛没有权威。多讽刺爱摆架子的人。

pinyin: àn xià hú lu fú qǐ piáo
literal: press · down · gourd · float · up · ladle
natural: fix one problem and another pops up

meaning.en: One problem is solved and another appears, like pressing a gourd under water while a ladle pops up.
meaning.zh: 解决了一个问题，另一个问题又冒出来。

equivalents: as soon as one is fixed another pops up

examples.zh: 这个系统的漏洞按下葫芦浮起瓢，怎么也修不完。
examples.en: The bugs in this system are a whack-a-mole; they can never all be fixed.

examples.zh: 管理小孩就像按下葫芦浮起瓢。
examples.en: Handling kids is like pressing one gourd down while another bobs up.

usage.en: The image is of trying to push gourds and ladles under water: when one goes down, another bobs up. Usually 按下葫芦起了瓢 too.
usage.zh: 形象是水里按下葫芦，瓢又浮起来。也说“按下葫芦起了瓢”。

pinyin: zhī zhī qí yī, bù zhī qí èr
literal: only · know · its · one · not · know · its · two
natural: know only one side of things

meaning.en: To know only part of a matter and miss the rest.
meaning.zh: 只了解事物的一部分，不了解全面。

equivalents: see only part of the picture

examples.zh: 你只知其一，不知其二，别乱下结论。
examples.en: You know only half the story; don't jump to conclusions.

examples.zh: 他只知其一，不知其二，却在那里指手画脚。
examples.en: He knows only a part of it, yet he's holding forth.

usage.en: Typically a polite rebuke. Often followed by 不要 / 你不知道. It also appears as a pair with 知其一，不知其二 as a shorter form.
usage.zh: 多用于委婉批评别人了解不全面。

pinyin: hū zhī jí lái, huī zhī jí qù
literal: call · him · at once · come, wave · him · at once · go

meaning.en: Ready to come when called and go when dismissed; at someone's disposal.
meaning.zh: 叫他就来，赶他就走，形容完全听人使唤。

examples.zh: 他把下属当成呼之即来，挥之即去的工具。
examples.en: He treats subordinates as tools that come when called and go when dismissed.

examples.zh: 我不是呼之即来，挥之即去的人。
examples.en: I'm not someone who comes and goes at your whim.

usage.en: Often with a tone of resentment, about being treated as a servant. Formal-leaning set phrase.
usage.zh: 常带不满，形容被当作仆人使唤。

pinyin: hǎo xīn dàng chéng lǘ gān fèi
literal: good · intention · taken · as · donkey · liver · lungs

meaning.en: Having one's good intentions taken as ill will.
meaning.zh: 把别人的好意当成坏心。

equivalents: have one's kindness thrown back in one's face

examples.zh: 我是为你好，你却好心当成驴肝肺。
examples.en: I meant well, and you took it as malice.

examples.zh: 真是好心当成驴肝肺，下次不管了。
examples.en: My kindness was thrown back at me; I won't help next time.

usage.en: Usually appears as 把好心当成驴肝肺. Donkey liver and lungs are viewed as worthless offal, hence a person who values kindness at nothing.
usage.zh: 常说“把好心当成驴肝肺”，驴肝肺比喻毫无价值。

pinyin: shēng mìng bù xī, zhàn dòu bù zhǐ
literal: life · not · cease, fighting · not · stop
natural: fight on to the last breath

meaning.en: Keep struggling as long as one lives.
meaning.zh: 只要活着，就要奋斗到底。

equivalents: fight on as long as I live
never stop fighting while there is life

examples.zh: 他用生命不息，战斗不止的精神工作到最后一天。
examples.en: He worked to his last day with the spirit of fighting on as long as he lived.

examples.zh: 生命不息，战斗不止，是他一生的写照。
examples.en: Fight on to the last breath: that sums up his whole life.

usage.en: A slogan in political speeches, obituaries and sporting contexts. Formal register.
usage.zh: 用于演讲、悼词、体育场合的口号，较正式。

pinyin: kàn cài chī fàn, liàng tǐ cái yī
literal: look · at · dishes · eat · rice, measure · body · cut · clothes
natural: suit the means to the case

meaning.en: To adjust one's actions to the actual situation, as one eats according to what is on the table and cuts clothes to fit.
meaning.zh: 根据实际情况办事，因地制宜。

equivalents: cut your coat according to your cloth

examples.zh: 做预算要看菜吃饭，量体裁衣。
examples.en: A budget should be tailored to what you actually have.

examples.zh: 政策必须看菜吃饭，量体裁衣。
examples.en: Policy must be fitted to the real situation.

usage.en: Often in the long form 看菜吃饭，量体裁衣; either half can stand alone with a similar sense.
usage.zh: 可只用前半或后半，意思相近。

text: 知其然而不知其所以然
pinyin: zhī qí rán ér bù zhī qí suǒ yǐ rán
literal: know · what · is · but · not · know · why · it · is
natural: know the what but not the why

meaning.en: To know how a thing is without understanding the reasons behind it.
meaning.zh: 只知道事情是这样，不明白为什么是这样。

equivalents: know the what but not the why
know it by rote without understanding

examples.zh: 学数学不能知其然而不知其所以然。
examples.en: In maths you can't just know what, without why.

examples.zh: 他知其然而不知其所以然，一遇到新题就卡住了。
examples.en: He knows that it works but not why, and he's stuck on new problems.

usage.en: A criticism of rote learning. Often used with 不能 / 要 to urge understanding.
usage.zh: 批评死记硬背。常说“不能知其然而不知其所以然”。

pinyin: zhī wú bù yán, yán wú bù jìn
literal: know · nothing · not · say, say · nothing · not · exhaust

meaning.en: To speak frankly about everything one knows, holding nothing back.
meaning.zh: 知道的都说，说就说得透彻。

examples.zh: 只要我知道的，一定知无不言，言无不尽。
examples.en: What I know, I will tell you frankly and fully.

examples.zh: 请专家们知无不言，言无不尽。
examples.en: We ask the experts to speak candidly and completely.

usage.en: Used when offering or requesting frank advice. Formal-leaning.
usage.zh: 多用于表示坦诚直言或请对方直言。

pinyin: shén nǚ yǒu xīn, xiāng wáng wú mèng
literal: goddess · has · heart, King Xiang · has · no · dream

meaning.en: One person's feelings are not returned; unrequited love.
meaning.zh: 一方有情，另一方无意，指单相思。

examples.zh: 可惜神女有心，襄王无梦，他们没能走到一起。
examples.en: Sadly the feelings were one-sided, and they never got together.

examples.zh: 别人对她神女有心，襄王无梦。
examples.en: She likes him, but he has no interest in her.

usage.en: A play on the Chu story of King Xiang's encounter with the goddess of Wu Mountain (in Song Yu's rhapsody); the usual saying is 襄王有梦，神女无心. This version reverses the roles and is used for any gender.
usage.zh: 由“襄王有梦，神女无心”化出，角色相反，现可指任何一方单相思。

pinyin: qián duō shì shǎo lí jiā jìn
literal: money · more · work · less · distance · home · near

meaning.en: The ideal job: good pay, little work and a short commute.
meaning.zh: 理想的工作：薪水高、事情少、离家近。

equivalents: good pay, light work, short commute

examples.zh: 谁不想找个钱多事少离家近的工作？
examples.en: Who wouldn't want a job with good pay, little work and a short commute?

examples.zh: 他的择业标准就是钱多事少离家近。
examples.en: His criteria for a job is simply: good pay, little work, near home.

usage.en: Internet jingle often followed by 位高权重责任轻 (high status, little responsibility). Usually used jokingly about impossible wishes.
usage.zh: 网络流行语，常半开玩笑地形容不现实的理想工作。

pinyin: guān guān nán guò, guān guān guò
literal: pass · pass · hard · to cross, pass · pass · cross

meaning.en: Though each pass is hard to get through, one gets through each in turn.
meaning.zh: 每道难关都不容易，但总能一关一关地闯过去。

equivalents: get through one hurdle after another

examples.zh: 路再难，也要关关难过，关关过。
examples.en: Whatever the hurdles, we get through them one at a time.

examples.zh: 创业之路关关难过，关关过。
examples.en: The path of a start-up is hard but each hurdle gets crossed.

usage.en: A line popular as encouragement, often followed by 步步难行，步步行. Can be used with a determined tone.
usage.zh: 常作鼓励语，多与“步步难行，步步行”连用。

pinyin: fēng zhōng zhī zhú
literal: wind · in · 's · candle

meaning.en: Something or someone on the verge of perishing; extremely precarious, especially an old person near death.
meaning.zh: 比喻随时可能熄灭、消亡的事物，多指老人垂危。

examples.zh: 老人已是风中之烛，医生让家属做好准备。
examples.en: The old man is a candle in the wind, and the doctors told the family to prepare.

examples.zh: 这家企业如今成了风中之烛。
examples.en: The firm is now like a candle guttering in the wind.

usage.en: Literary image, as in 风烛残年; typical in 犹如风中之烛.
usage.zh: 常说“风烛残年”，是同一意象。

pinyin: yī gè tiān nán, yī gè dì běi
literal: one · sky · south, one · earth · north

meaning.en: Two people or things far apart, in totally different places.
meaning.zh: 相隔很远，各在一方。

equivalents: at opposite ends of the earth

examples.zh: 毕业后，我们一个天南，一个地北。
examples.en: After graduation we ended up at opposite ends of the country.

examples.zh: 两个人一个天南，一个地北，很难见面。
examples.en: They're at opposite ends of the earth and can seldom meet.

usage.en: Compare 天南地北 (all over the place). Said of friends and lovers parted by distance.
usage.zh: 可与“天南地北”比较，多用于朋友、恋人相隔两地。

text: 一部二十四史，不知从何说起
pinyin: yī bù èr shí sì shǐ, bù zhī cóng hé shuō qǐ
literal: one · set · twenty-four · histories, not · know · where · to · begin · telling
natural: too much to tell, where to begin

meaning.en: The story is so long and tangled that one doesn't know where to start.
meaning.zh: 事情头绪太多，不知从哪里说起。

examples.zh: 这件事说来话长，一部二十四史，不知从何说起。
examples.en: It's a long story, and I don't even know where to begin.

examples.zh: 你问我的经历？一部二十四史，不知从何说起。
examples.en: You ask about my experiences? There's so much, I don't know where to start.

usage.en: 二十四史 are the twenty-four official dynastic histories; a stock joke about a too-long story. Often as a humorous sigh.
usage.zh: 二十四史是二十四部正史，常用来夸张地形容事情繁多。

pinyin: bù zuò sǐ jiù bù huì sǐ
literal: not · court · death · then · not · die
natural: don't ask for trouble and you won't get it

meaning.en: If you don't do stupid, risky things, you won't get yourself into trouble.
meaning.zh: 不自找麻烦、不冒险，就不会招来灾祸。

equivalents: if you don't ask for it you won't get it

examples.zh: 不作死就不会死，他自己乱吃东西才进了医院。
examples.en: No one forced him; eating all that junk was how he ended up in hospital.

examples.zh: 他活该，不作死就不会死。
examples.en: Serves him right; if he hadn't asked for trouble it wouldn't have found him.

usage.en: Internet slang popular since the 2010s, often in the form 不作死就不会死 as a comment after someone's own foolishness. 作死 is northern slang for 'asking for it'.
usage.zh: 2010年代流行的网络语，常用于评论别人自找苦吃。“作死”是方言，意思是自找麻烦。
